verdict.rationale: Mercury Command lets users ask questions and hand off bookkeeping tasks 'in plain language,' directly matching the natural-language command story, and this is documented across multiple first-party sources describing bulk actions, categorization, and Q&A. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Command's NL capabilities and confirmation that the broader agent-facing API/MCP layer (still described as 'soon') doesn't gate deeper command coverage.
